name: Sachin Yadav
bio:
Sachin is the Marketing Manager of LangNation Institute and has more than 5 years of experience in the Marketing field.

Sachin is also the Founder & Director of Tech Site World (Marketing analyst Company). Being the Marketing Manager of “LangNation – The German School”, Sachin is carrying many responsibilities such as project management and Digital Marketing, etc. Sachin also enjoys Spending time with his family and focus on growing business.

Qualification 

  • Master’s in commerce From Madras University
  • Bachelor’s in commerce From Delhi University
  • Business Analytics from EDU Pristine
  • Business Accounting & Taxation from EDU Pristine
  • Certified by SAP ( Systems Application and Products )

Experience 

  • 5 years’ experience of Maths Teacher 
  • 5 years’ experience in Marketing analyst
  • 2 years’ experience in project management

name: Abhishek Sharma
bio:
Abhishek Sharma is the senior teacher of LangNation Institute and has more than 5 years of experience in the German field and is an active member of InDaf.

In his early years, he worked with a German company as a research and development expert. He worked in various MNCs and dealt with German clients with his flawless speaking and listening skills.

In LangNation Institute, he handles A1 to B2 level courses and is responsible for Weekend story sessions, Stammtisch, and doubt sessions in Ilmenau, Germany. His fluent German-speaking skill is just outstanding. He is also responsible for all LangNation’s event in Ilmenau and Thüringen, Germany.

Qualification:

  • German C1 and C2 levels from Hamburg, Germany.
  • German Teacher Training Course.
  • Master Maschinenbau, Rostock University
  • Master Fahrzeugtechnik, TU Ilmenau.

Experience:

  • 3 years as a German Trainer
  • 1 years as a German Translator
